description: INERTIAL MASS BY ACTION. The operational definition of inertial mass, F=ma inverted: push an object with a known impulse J, observe its acceleration a, and m = J/a = impulse/Δv (resistance to the push IS the mass). When a SEEN object is pushed repeatedly (a sustained force), it accelerates uniformly; the eye tracks it as ONE Region and the dimension-generic order-N loop (time_axis / TimeInfer) mints an ORDER-2 latent:time dimension whose coeffs[1] leading vector IS the perceived per-tick Δv (the constant acceleration = J/m). This rule reads the impulse J recorded on the motion Observation (the action parameter) and that minted acceleration and mints a MassScalar = IDiv(J, |a|), linked to the PERCEIVED Region (grouping is by the eye's persistent Region identity, never a world id). No mass is ever published by the world; the scalar is DISCOVERED from the push. A single push (one impulse then coast) is constant velocity -> order-1 -> no acceleration -> this rule never fires (insufficient evidence). Idempotent per Observation via the yielded_mass marker, so repeated pushes with DIFFERENT impulses each mint a MassScalar and J/a is INVARIANT across them (= the mass).

microtheory.name: mass_by_action
microtheory.description: impulse / observed-acceleration -> minted per-object inertial-mass scalar, grouped by perceived Region; the operational (F=ma-inverted) definition of inertial mass, discovered by pushing seen objects

rules.name: mass_from_push
rules.comment: A time-inferred motion Observation of a pushed Region, carrying the impulse J (action parameter) and an ORDER-2 latent:time dimension (uniform acceleration = J/m), mints a MassScalar = IDiv(J, |acceleration|) on that Region. |acceleration| = |coeffs[1][0]| + |coeffs[1][1]| (the order-2 leading finite difference; exactly one axis is nonzero for an axis-aligned push, so the sum is its magnitude, direction-agnostic). Guards: status time_inferred; order exactly 2 (a single push is order-1 -> no mass); nonzero acceleration; idempotent per Observation (no yielded_mass yet), so different-impulse pushes on one Region each mint a scalar and J/a is invariant.
